correctness.rationale: For any p in (0,1), t in (0,1] and every integer m>=2, iid one-shot marks force A interior sites of an A block to accept and leave two independent exterior blocking half-lines. Their two linear exclusion ODEs solve explicitly to f_A; integrating independent endpoints gives p^m t^(m-2) J_A(t)^2. Inclusion–exclusion at cluster edges yields all d_m, geometric conditional tails and exact two-species inverse ratios; the same known one-site marginal gives strict positive adjacent covariance. Priority dependencies terminate almost surely by factorial bounds; ergodicity follows as a factor of iid. An independent finite-chain dynamic program and separate numerical quadratures in verify.py passed 1854 assertions. Finite checks are not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Exact cluster morphology is a direct, nontrivial observable for two-species antagonistic deposition, not a cosmetic restatement of the known density. The all-length law gives the entire maximal cluster tail in one formula and distinguishes cluster-sampled from site-sampled measurements. The two geometric tail ratios give an exact inverse calibration of both process progress and species bias, a physically meaningful identification unavailable from a single marginal. The correlation consequence identifies the local dependence created by accepted cluster growth. Scope is limited to one-shot nearest-neighbor dynamics and infinite-window identifiability, with no finite-sample error bound.
